role: Codable model for structured interval workouts: IntervalStep (timed or distance step with a target and label) and IntervalPlan (ordered steps + whole-plan repeatCount), plus three built-in preset plans shown in WorkoutPreflightView.
types: IntervalStep: struct (Codable, Equatable, Identifiable) — one step; id = index
IntervalStep.Target: enum — zone / hrRange / paceSecPerKm / effort
IntervalPlan: struct (Codable, Equatable, Identifiable) — named step list with repeatCount and presets
state: mem:IntervalPlan.presets (static let: 'Easy base (30 min Z2)' id 1111…, "5×3' tempo @ Z4" id 2222…, '4×30/30 VO₂ (2 sets)' id 3333…)
toplevel: IntervalPlan.presets is a static let evaluated lazily on first access (WorkoutPreflightView.swift:785); it builds three plans with fixed UUID literals via presetID and the 30/30 plan via thirtyThirtySteps(sets: 2). All Codable/Equatable conformances are synthesized.

flags.text: displayName/displayLabel comments speak of 'a user plan's name as written' and 'a label the user wrote', but no code outside IntervalPlan.presets ever constructs an IntervalStep/IntervalPlan (grep 'IntervalStep(' finds only IntervalPlan.swift), so only preset plans exist.

Header says per-step stats (avg HR, distance, pace) are captured at finalize so the post-summary shows a per-interval breakdown; no code in the repo computes or stores per-interval stats (grep for interval stats/breakdown finds only this comment).
IntervalStep.isWork is documented as driving session-level TRIMP weighting, but nothing reads it (grep '.isWork' finds no reader in app or tests); it is set only in the preset literals.

units.does: Identifiable id = step index (stable only within one plan).
units.entry: Identifiable conformance requirement only; no SwiftUI ForEach or other identity use of IntervalStep exists in the repo (ForEach is only over IntervalPlan.presets at WorkoutPreflightView.swift:785).

units.does: Maps the stored English label to its localized string for the 8 preset labels via LanguageManager.appBundle; any other label is returned unchanged. Used by FitnessRecordingView.swift:433 for the live step row.

English AI-facing phrase: label, then amount (duration or distance, omitted when neither), then target, joined by ' — ' (e.g. 'warm up — 5 min — @ Zone 2'). Read by WorkoutRecorder+Context.liveIntervalProgressSnapshot for workout.live.interval.* facts.

flags.text: The doc comment's examples ('warm up — 5 min @ Zone 2', 'interval 3 of 5 — 800 m @ Zone 4') do not match the output: the target is joined with a second ' — ' separator ('warm up — 5 min — @ Zone 2') and no 'N of M' counter is ever produced.

units.does: Duration text when durationSec is set ('N min', 'N min S s', or 'S s'), else distance text ('X.X km' at >=1000 m, else 'N m'), else [] for an open-ended step.

branches.effect: true: formats time (distance ignored even if also set); false: falls to distance
true: ['N min S s']; false: ['S s']

units.does: Formats the target: '@ Zone z', '@ lo–hi bpm', '@ m:ss/km', or '@ <effort rawValue> effort'.

Total steps across all repeats = steps.count x max(1, repeatCount). Not read anywhere: FitnessRecordingView.swift:430 and WorkoutRecorder+Context.swift:340 read IntervalController.totalSteps (flatSteps.count), not this property.

flags.text: IntervalPlan.totalSteps has no reader in app or tests; every '.totalSteps' use resolves to IntervalController.totalSteps.
Same computation as IntervalController.totalSteps, which expands steps max(1, repeatCount) times in load(plan:) and returns the count.

units.does: Localized plan name for the three preset names; any other name returned as stored. Used by WorkoutPreflightView.swift:786 preset chips.
Sum of timed steps' durationSec × max(1, repeatCount); distance-only steps contribute 0.

flags.text: estimatedDurationSec has no reader anywhere in the repo (grep across .swift and .md finds only its declaration), tests included.

units.does: Builds a UUID from a literal; traps with preconditionFailure naming the literal if malformed.

branches.effect: preconditionFailure (crash at first presets access); all three literals are valid so this never fires

units.does: Builds the flat 30/30 step list: a 10-min Z2 warm-up then `sets` copies of [30s hard Z5, 30s easy Z2 ×3 alternations, 30s hard, 3-min rest Z1], with sequential indices and isWork true only for 'hard'.

branches.cond: label missing from the zones dictionary
branches.effect: falls back to zone 2; unreachable because every spec label ('warm up','hard','easy','rest') is a key
